title: "What Does Double Mean in Backgammon?"

<p class="bms-glossary-term-name">Double</p>
<p class="bms-glossary-aliases"><strong>Also called:</strong> <span id="alias-double-in">Double In</span>, <span id="alias-double-out">Double Out</span>, <span id="alias-turn-the-crank">Turn the Crank</span>, <span id="alias-turn-the-cube">Turn the Cube</span>, <span id="alias-twist-the-cube">Twist the Cube</span></p>
<p class="bms-glossary-definition">Double means to offer to continue the game for twice its current value, or a roll showing the same number on both dice. The term gives players a shared way to talk about this part of the game.</p>
